title: Ex 2.5 #8 · Truth table for P ∨ (Q ∧ ∼R)
prompt: Build a truth table for $P \vee (Q \wedge \sim R)$ and enter the truth value of the whole statement in each row.
answer_format: Eight T/F values, one per row, top to bottom, like T T F T T F T T. Rows (P, Q, R) go TTT, TTF, TFT, TFF, FTT, FTF, FFT, FFF, as in the book. Helper columns are optional steps, like ~P : F F F F T T T T.
answer: T T T T F T F F
hints: Make helper columns for ∼R and then Q ∧ ∼R. Q ∧ ∼R is true only when Q is true and R is false.
Every row where P is true gets T. In the other rows, copy the column of Q ∧ ∼R.
solution: $\sim R$ is F T F T F T F T, and $Q \wedge \sim R$ is F T F F F T F F.
The top four rows have $P$ true, so they are T. The bottom four copy $Q \wedge \sim R$: F T F F.
So the column is T T T T F T F F.

reference.note: This exact exercise, restated in ProofLab's words. Uses the truth tables for ∧, ∨, ∼, ⇒ and ⇔ (Sections 2.2–2.5).

submission.answer: T T T T F T F F
